question: Where does the tenth chapter conclude within the cited tantric corpus?
premises: The statement marks an ending with iti
The location is given as śrī ṣoḍaśanityātantreṣu in śrīkādimata
The section is identified as the tenth paṭala
inference: The tenth chapter concludes in the revered kādimata within the sixteen nityā tantras
plain_english: Thus ends the tenth chapter in the revered kādimata, within the revered sixteen nityā tantras. (p. 191)
